appDesc.message: Remaining Claude, ChatGPT & Gemini usage — 5-hour & weekly limits — in a popup and toolbar badge. Reads only your own usage pages.

reset_date_fmt.description: Reset date shown when it is more than a day away. {mo} month, {day} day, {wd} weekday, {hh}:{mi} 24h time.

checked.description: {age} is a relative time like '3m ago'

note_no_permission.message: No site permission. Turn the service off and on to allow.

badge_pct.description: {pct} is the remaining percent, e.g. '50%'. Shown in the toolbar tooltip.

badge_sep.description: Joins the value and the reset time in the toolbar tooltip.

badge_note_fmt.description: Wraps a short status note at the end of a toolbar tooltip line.

refused_note.message: You must allow the site permission to turn this on.

note_main.message: Numbers are the remaining percent. Gemini is read while its usage page (gemini.google.com/usage) tab is open.

note_main_used.message: Numbers are the used percent. Gemini is read while its usage page (gemini.google.com/usage) tab is open.

overlay_window_note.message: Closing this window also closes the always-on-top overlay.

overlay_empty.message: Turn on a service in the popup.

account_n.description: Name of a Claude organization whose plan is unknown. {n} is its position, e.g. 2.

peers_label_placeholder.description: Placeholder for the profile name field

peers_hint.message: Turn this on in each Chrome profile where Leeway is installed to see their usage here too. Needs the Leeway helper (Windows).

peers_none.message: No other profile has shared its usage yet.

peers_helper_missing_cause.message: The Leeway helper isn't installed, or its installation is broken.

peers_helper_missing_action.message: Get the helper below and run it once, then turn this on again.

peers_helper_forbidden_cause.message: The helper is installed but doesn't allow this copy of Leeway.

peers_helper_forbidden_action.message: Get the latest helper below and run it again. An unpacked copy needs: leeway-helper.exe install --extension-id {id}

peers_helper_blocked_cause.message: Your administrator has blocked Chrome from talking to helper programs.

peers_helper_blocked_action.message: Reinstalling won't help; ask your administrator.

peers_helper_failed_cause.message: The helper is installed but didn't start, or stopped before it answered.

peers_helper_failed_action.message: Run leeway-helper.exe again: it repairs the setup, then checks each step.

peers_helper_outdated_cause.message: This helper ({version}) is older than Leeway needs ({min}).

peers_helper_outdated_action.message: Get the latest helper below and run it.

peers_updated.description: {age} is a relative time like '3m ago'
